content_sections.heading: High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher Recruitment 2026 - Overview
High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The High Court of Jharkhand has announced 25 vacancies for Law Researcher/Research Associate posts.

content_sections.heading: High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the following educational qualification requirements: Fresh Law Graduates or Post Graduates from a University/College recognized by the Bar Council of India are eligible. Students studying in the 5th year of a 5-year Law course or final year of a 3-year Law course are also eligible, subject to passing the final year LL.B examination before engagement. Candidates who have passed all examinations in the first attempt with at least 60% aggregate marks are eligible to apply. Candidates having familiarity with computers will get preference during the selection process.

content_sections.heading: High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Law Researchers/Research Associates will receive a consolidated honorarium/stipend of Rs. 40,000 per month.

content_sections.heading: High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates have to submit the scanned copy of the filled application form along with scanned copies of required documents in a single PDF file through email. The PDF file size should not exceed 10 MB.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website of High Court of Jharkhand. Download the prescribed application form. Fill in all required details carefully. Attach scanned copies of required documents. Convert the application and documents into a single PDF file. Send the PDF file through email to the prescribed email address before 28 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher Application
content_sections.text: Matriculation Certificate as proof of date of birth Law Graduation/Post Graduation marksheets Law Graduation/Post Graduation degree certificate Recommendation by designated Senior Advocate or Head of last Law School/College/University Computer certificate, if available

content_sections.heading: High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection of candidates will be based on merit and interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely contractual and does not provide any right to permanent employment. Candidates must ensure they meet eligibility conditions before applying. Original documents will be required during document verification/interview. Incomplete applications will be rejected. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher Recruitment 2026 is an opportunity for eligible law graduates and postgraduates to work as Law Researchers/Research Associates in the High Court of Jharkhand, Ranchi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Jharkhand High Court Law Researcher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 25 Law Researcher/Research Associate posts are available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Rs. 40,000 per month as honorarium/stipend.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for High Court Law Researcher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 years and 28 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required for Jharkhand High Court Law Researcher Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Law Graduation or Post Graduation degree from a Bar Council of India recognized University/College.

faq.question: Q6. Can final year law students apply for High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher Recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, students studying in the 5th year of a 5-year Law course or final year of a 3-year Law course can apply, subject to passing the final LL.B examination before engagement.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Jharkhand High Court Law Researcher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on merit and interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for High Court of Jharkhand Law Researcher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending the filled application form and required documents through email in a single PDF file.
